sourceNote: Snapshot includes generated heat-generator loot; all tested JARs match local build artifacts byte for byte.
scope: ATM10 heat/bio effective settings; lava active and passive thermal accounting; whole-Joule to FE conversion and fractional output; output cap; aborted simulation rollback; normal block loot and replacement; full-item bio yield, block burn duration, partial-space rollback; fresh-JVM fractional and bio fuel persistence followed by continued generation. Retains turbine, fission, physical fusion ignition, heater, gas, machine and SPS checks. Nether passive heat is configuration-checked only. Generator external transfer limits, reactor recirculation and hot-state safety, equipment, progression and addons remain incomplete.
excludedAttempts: Initial fixture assumed that the first global post-tick included a generator update. Final fixture waits for every generator ticker to advance, applies inputs between ticks and checks exactly one tile update before measuring.

The next attempt passed thermal/fuel/rollback checks but exposed missing generation_remainder in generated block loot. runData, a separate main build and then QA build regenerated and packaged the component. Packaged loot was checked before the final seed. Failed worlds/evidence are archived separately.
